name: Gretel
source: [url=/c91602]Jack's[/url] classmate who is a member of the swimming club, and is always seen wearing nothing but her swimsuit because she's too lazy to change into her school uniform. An extremely curious girl who has a unique view of the world. She loves sweets a lot. Her brother Hanzel, though not shown, is also a student at the school; he is known for his tall height (200 cm) and handsome face.
